_readme: Your company's details. Every value below is an EXAMPLE: replace it with your own, then restart the backend. See company_profile.py for what each field does. Values saved in the app's Settings screens override these per office.
pay_summary: EDIT ME: describe how the role is paid (base, commission, bonuses).
about_company: EDIT ME: two or three sentences about what your company does, who it works for and why people join.

field_app._note: Optional. If your new starters install a team app before day one, name it and give its install page. Leave blank to drop that block from the starter email.

starter_template.parking_text: On-street parking only. Public transport is recommended.
Free parking is available on site.

starter_template_defaults.id_text: Please bring a form of photo ID. Everything else is handled through digital onboarding.
starter_template_defaults.food_text: Snacks and refreshments will be provided.

partner_feed._note: Only used by the optional stage-event export at GET /api/partner/stage-events (needs PARTNER_FEED_API_KEY). Ignore it otherwise.
